description: Arabic-script readings for Latin A-Z in ar_XA navigation text. These readings are intended for TTS training and inference text normalization; Latin letters should be converted to these forms before synthesis/training.
notes: P is mapped to بِي because standard Arabic does not have a native /p/ phoneme.
V is mapped to فِي because standard Arabic does not have a native /v/ phoneme.
Z uses زِدْ for a broader Arabic-local navigation reading rather than the US-only zee reading.
Each navigation utterance should contain at most one letter reading unless a later dataset explicitly targets multi-letter names.
